# Angular Project Instructions

This is an Angular 21 application.

## Important

* Follow `AGENTS.md` for project-wide development rules.
* Use the Angular CLI MCP server for Angular workspace analysis, code generation, builds, and tests when applicable.
* Use the latest stable Angular APIs supported by Angular 21.
* Prefer official Angular APIs over third-party alternatives when practical.
* Do not introduce legacy Angular patterns into new code.
* Before implementing unfamiliar Angular functionality, verify the API using the Angular MCP server or current official Angular documentation.

When modifying existing code, preserve the existing architecture unless the task explicitly requests modernization or refactoring.

Always verify significant changes with the appropriate build and tests.
